explanation: Without CTTS, final packet next_dts uses st->duration; for positive start 512 ticks, final dts383488 and duration384000 imply 512 despite STTS sample duration1024. At offsets where next_dts < DTS, duration remains unset and AAC parser infers1024; no such offset workaround is used.
